title: First contact
solution: Open field-note.txt in a text editor or run cat field-note.txt. The last line contains the complete flag. Copy it including the dfCTF{...} wrapper. Inspect the supplied evidence before trying complicated tools.

title: The midnight request
solution: Find the /training/export request in access.log. URL-decode its evidence query parameter; %7B and %7D become braces. The resulting value is the complete flag. Keep original logs intact and investigate a copy.

title: Cookie crumbs
solution: Read the Set-Cookie header in response.txt, extract the training_evidence value before the semicolon, and Base64-decode it. The resulting text is the complete flag. Base64 changes representation; it provides no confidentiality or integrity.
